artifacts.tutankhamun.title: Golden Mask of Tutankhamun
artifacts.tutankhamun.description: The golden funerary mask of Tutankhamun is one of the most iconic masterpieces of ancient Egyptian civilization. Crafted from gold and precious stones, the mask was designed to protect the Pharaoh in the afterlife and symbolize divine power and immortality.
artifacts.tutankhamun.history: Discovered in 1925 by Howard Carter in the Valley of the Kings, the mask became one of the greatest archaeological discoveries in modern history.
artifacts.ramesses.title: Statue of Ramesses II
artifacts.ramesses.description: This monumental statue of Ramesses II represents one of the most powerful rulers in Egyptian history.
artifacts.ramesses.history: Ramesses II ruled Egypt for more than sixty years and commissioned some of the most remarkable temples and monuments in ancient Egypt.
artifact.defaultHistory: This artifact reflects the artistic and spiritual legacy of ancient Egypt.
artifact.bottomNote: Every artifact carries a story — explore its details, discover its history, and step deeper into the world of ancient Egypt.
